recent_posts.title: How to transfer Google Play developer account ownership securely
recent_posts.summary: Google Play Console now supports a secure, official process for transferring developer account ownership. The flow involves initiating the transfer via the Users and Permissions page, a mandatory 7-day cooling-off period during which any team member can cancel to prevent unauthorized takeovers, and a final verification step where the new owner confirms their information. Once complete, the new owner gains full ownership and the previous owner becomes a global admin.

recent_posts.title: How to supercharge android game development: vulcan, 16kb pages, & more
recent_posts.summary: A Google I/O-style session covering several Android game development topics. Mark Doctorow announces Android is now Vulkan-first, with over 50% of new Unity games using Vulkan and nearly 100% of Android 14+ devices supporting Vulkan 1.1. ANGLE is offered as an OpenGL ES emulation layer for legacy games. Stephen Morlin explains 16KB memory pages, which deliver 2–9% CPU/memory performance gains, up to 2–3 extra FPS in games, and 7.4% power reduction, with NDK 28+ and Gradle 8.5.1+ supporting it out of the box. Val O'Donnell covers Google Play premium game features including Play Game Services, saved games API, free trials, Play Pass, and wish listing. Emil Kerr from Funday Games shares the Deep Rock Galactic Survivor PC-to-mobile porting story, covering flow field pathfinding (60% navigation cost reduction), VFX Graph crash issues on Vulkan, portrait/landscape support, and community playtesting. Simon Cook previews the new Android GPU Profiler (next-gen AGI), an open-source Vulkan profiler built on Perfetto and GFXReconstruct, targeting open beta mid-2025.

recent_posts.title: How to migrate your app to 16 KB page size
recent_posts.summary: Android apps need to be updated for 16 KB page size compatibility. Key steps include upgrading to AGP 8.5.1+, rebuilding native code with NDK R28 or above, avoiding hardcoded page size assumptions, and ensuring all native dependencies are also compatible. Pure Java/Kotlin apps are already handled by the updated Android runtime, but apps with native code or native dependencies require explicit updates.

recent_posts.title: How Google made their Android app start faster
recent_posts.summary: A Google Android performance engineer shares how the team improved app startup and search latency by reordering initialization steps in the Android Google app. The key insight was that initializing the web fragment (which renders search results) too late caused high search latency, but moving it earlier caused startup latency to spike 5x. The solution was 'intentional initialization': deleting unused code, reordering initialization blocks to match when they're actually needed, and leveraging gaps in the startup timeline. Specific wins included prioritizing keyboard display before secondary UI (the biggest growth driver for the team in Q2), moving Chrome Custom Tabs pre-warming later, and pre-warming WebView profile and instance earlier. The strategy reduced startup interactive latency, cut cancellation rates, and improved search latency simultaneously.

Compose animations - Android Developers Backstage
top_posts.summary: Jetpack Compose significantly improves Android animation capabilities by offering a unified API system. The new animation layers, including AnimationSpec and Animatable, facilitate simpler and more flexible animations. The LookAhead feature optimizes layout prediction, enhancing performance and user experience. The Shared Element Transition API, recently introduced, helps create smooth transitions between composable elements.

top_posts.title: Android Developer Story: AllTrails sees 60% higher monthly retention from Wear OS users
top_posts.summary: AllTrails, a popular app for outdoor enthusiasts, reports a 60% higher monthly retention among Wear OS users. The app, which offers 500,000 trails in over 200 countries, utilizes tools like Jetpack Compose, Android Studio, and Horologist to enhance the user experience. Key features include hands-free navigation, favourite and nearby trails, Wrong Turn alerts, and live sharing. The developers plan to incorporate more features like maps and a compass in future updates.
